subject.title: refactor(qa): finish Matrix QA Lab ownership

question: After the predecessor stack is landed and this branch is restacked, should an eligible administrator or security owner authorize removal of the `qa-matrix` workspace package and lockfile importer on the resulting exact head?
rationale: The removal is intentional and well-tested, but repository policy delegates dependency-graph authorization to an eligible human and the currently dirty stacked head is not a stable authorization target.

options.title: Restack and authorize removal
options.body: Land the predecessor PRs, rebase this cleanup onto their exact result, confirm the effective diff removes only the migrated temporary package, then authorize that exact head.

options.title: Retain the temporary package
options.body: Keep `qa-matrix` temporarily if maintainer review finds a remaining source-build, plugin API, or upgrade consumer that has not moved to QA Lab.

recommendation.title: Restack and authorize removal
recommendation.body: Land the predecessor PRs, rebase this cleanup onto their exact result, confirm the effective diff removes only the migrated temporary package, then authorize that exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: Release and merge history makes steipete the strongest available routing candidate for an exact-head repository dependency authorization.
